title: Illustration / Shape language / Construction
slide_intent: Limit the building blocks of illustration because repeated geometry makes different subjects feel related.
strategic_value: A rounded construction vocabulary can connect Duolingo objects and characters without requiring the same silhouette.
demonstration: Blue rounded shapes and constructed pear, cat and frog drawings contrast with a crossed-out set of sharp or elliptical shapes.
practical_value: Build new drawings from the three stated base shapes and keep cut edges rounded.

content_islands.name: Accepted and rejected geometry
content_islands.spec: Place blue rounded examples beside the pink crossed-out shapes in the upper left panel.

content_islands.name: Constructed subjects
content_islands.spec: Align the pear, cat and frog construction overlays beneath the shape comparison.

content_islands.name: Construction guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and explanation of three base shapes at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The source names rounded rectangles, circles and rounded triangles as base shapes and allows cutting them with a pathfinder tool.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text requires rounded edges and calls pointy shapes off-brand.

ingredient.name: Rounded illustration primitives
ingredient.role: Unify drawings through a recurring geometric vocabulary.
ingredient.application: Construct with rounded rectangles, circles and rounded triangles; cut them when needed while retaining rounded edges.
ingredient.scope: Historical illustration guidance; the four displayed blue specimens include a cut form, not four independent base-shape categories.
